修改后的代码逻辑如下：
```python
def chunk_overlap(text: str, max_len: int, overlap: int) -> list:
    if not text or max_len <= 0 or overlap >= max_len:
        return []

    chunks = []
    start = 0
    while start < len(text):
        end = min(start + max_len, len(text))
        if len(chunks) == 0 or end - start == overlap:
            chunks.append(text[start:end])
            start = end - overlap
        else:
            chunks.append(text[start:end - overlap])
            start = end - overlap

    return chunks
```
